title: Dima Hasao
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
info: Dimasa, Kuki, Naga, Hmar and others
body:
Dima Hasao (formerly North Cachar Hills) is a hilly district in southern Assam, with its headquarters at Haflong — Assam's only hill station.

Haflong

Haflong, at about 680 metres, is known for its lakes, pine-covered hills and views, and for Jatinga, a nearby village famous for a mysterious seasonal bird phenomenon.

People

The district is home to Dimasa, Kuki, Naga, Hmar, Karbi and other communities, and is an autonomous district under the Sixth Schedule. Its hills are rich in limestone, coal and forests.
